pages.title: Well Fed, Well Prepared
pages.text: Eat a prepared dish that actually activates a food blessing.

pages.title: Well Fed, Well Prepared
pages.text: Use food quality as preparation for an activity.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Read the dish-quality tooltip. Choose food that grants a blessing; eating the same dish again too soon may not refresh it.

pages.title: Use a meal for its effect
pages.text: Read the current food tooltip: a dish's native effects and its quality blessing can follow different rules. Its name alone guarantees no particular buff.

pages.title: Use cooking survival effects
pages.text: Native cooking effects can help with snow, healing near warmth, running, unsafe foods or absorbing damage through hunger. Read each dish's effect tooltip; quality blessings do not make every food equivalent.

pages.title: Use food to change encounters
pages.text: Sulfur and mustard effects can repel their corresponding enemies. Flatulence interacts with sneaking and rising; these are distinct food abilities, not universal mob pacification.

pages.title: Quality I, II and III grants one, two or three blessing traits fo
pages.text: Quality I, II and III grants one, two or three blessing traits for two, three or four minutes respectively. Foods governed by another bonus policy do not receive invented blessing traits.

pages.title: Different traits support melee, projectiles, sprint attacks or fi
pages.text: Different traits support melee, projectiles, sprint attacks or fighting at low health. An ordinary-hostile bonus does not automatically apply to every boss, and these bonuses do not treat players as ordinary targets.

pages.title: Fall, projectile, fire, freeze and poison/wither protection are d
pages.text: Fall, projectile, fire, freeze and poison/wither protection are different bounded traits. Food does not grant universal invulnerability or cover every defense-bypassing damage source.

pages.title: A suitable food trait can slightly increase ordinary experience f
pages.text: A suitable food trait can slightly increase ordinary experience from eligible creatures. Its native bonus cap and boss exclusions remain intact.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Hover food for hunger/saturation and hold it for recovery preview. Effect bars show duration rather than improving the meal. Tooltip/model settings alter presentation, not reward contents.
